source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("Nominations for county and rural councils")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Read on the page image: the News-Letter's Ballymoney section lists each division with its nominee (no party labels printed; the recorded party is not from this page). The Northern Whig's list of the same day (p. 3), cited before, does not carry this council. Kirkmoyle result from the Belfast News-Letter (5 October 1946, p. 3) and Belfast Telegraph (4 October 1946, p. 7); Dervock return from the Ballymena Weekly Telegraph (4 October 1946, p. 3).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Only Kirkmoyle was contested; Dervock was also reported as a contest at the nominations but was not polled, its return not being printed, so it is left out here. The remaining divisions were unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Citation corrected (w19-bna-fix, Nov 2026): the Northern Whig page cited before (20 September 1946, p. 3) has no Ballymoney list; the member is named in the Belfast News-Letter of the same day, p. 3 (page image), which prints no party labels, so Party_As_Printed is cleared (the recorded party is kept). Party (w19-fixes2, 19 Nov 2026): the recorded UUP had no source, since the Belfast News-Letter list of 20 September 1946, p. 3 prints no party labels. No party is recorded (unknown), as there is no consistent evidence: his return after (James Alexander Craig, Ballybregagh, 1949) carries no label. Renamed from 'Ballyeraigagh' to Ballycregagh (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Ballymoney Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Ballycregagh; the rounds were filed as Ballycregagh (1930, 1964); Ballyeraigagh (1946); Ballybregagh (1949). This round was filed as 'Ballyeraigagh' (the page prints 'Ballycraigagh', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed); the old address (ballyeraigagh) answers with a redirect to this one.
